_comment: Living Paper — universal 2D algorithm substrate. Use #algorithm:<name> to select cartridge.

living_paper.name: Living Paper
living_paper.description: Universal grabbable 2D canvas. Grab to run the algorithm, drop to pause. Defaults to simple random walk. Use #algorithm:<name> config to select cartridge.

living_paper_random_walk.name: Living Paper — Random Walk
living_paper_random_walk.description: Simple random walk on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_random_walk.qfep_connection: The plainest cartridge in the universal paper: one mark per step, stepping only while grabbed. Drop it and the walk halts mid-history — halting lives in your hand, not in the algorithm.

living_paper_brownian.name: Living Paper — Brownian Motion
living_paper_brownian.description: Brownian random walk on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_brownian.qfep_connection: A dot staggers across the page, each step a coin toss — Brownian motion held like a letter. The scribble that looks like nothing and is the signature of heat itself.

living_paper_levy.name: Living Paper — Lévy Flight
living_paper_levy.description: Lévy flight random walk on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_levy.qfep_connection: Mostly small steps, then a leap that rewrites the whole composition: the Lévy tail makes the page's history lopsided, and holding it means waiting for a jump you cannot schedule.

living_paper_self_avoiding.name: Living Paper — Self-Avoiding Walk
living_paper_self_avoiding.description: Self-avoiding random walk on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_self_avoiding.qfep_connection: A random walk that refuses to cross its own path — and so, unlike its Brownian cousin, can trap itself in a corner of the page. Memory added to chance: the walk becomes a polymer, and dead ends become possible.

living_paper_rule30.name: Living Paper — Rule 30
living_paper_rule30.description: Wolfram Rule 30 elementary cellular automaton on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_rule30.qfep_connection: Wolfram's Rule 30 pouring down the page — one row of cells, one lookup table, and chaos blooming from a single black cell. The page that proves how little a universe needs.

living_paper_rule110.name: Living Paper — Rule 110
living_paper_rule110.description: Wolfram Rule 110 (Turing-complete) elementary CA on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_rule110.qfep_connection: Rule 110, the elementary automaton that is Turing-complete — this unassuming sheet of triangles can, in principle, compute anything computable. The most powerful page in the gallery, indistinguishable at a glance from wallpaper.

living_paper_life.name: Living Paper — Game of Life
living_paper_life.description: Conway's Game of Life on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_life.qfep_connection: B3/S23 runs only while the sheet is in your hand — the most famous autonomous system in computing, here denied autonomy. Grab is its clock; drop is its halt.

living_paper_seeds.name: Living Paper — Seeds
living_paper_seeds.description: Seeds cellular automaton (explosive growth) on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_seeds.qfep_connection: The Seeds automaton — every living cell dies each tick, and only its sparks survive. Growth as pure explosion: the page as a firework that never stops going off.

living_paper_brians_brain.name: Living Paper — Brian's Brain
living_paper_brians_brain.description: Brian's Brain 3-state cellular automaton on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_brians_brain.qfep_connection: Brian's Brain: cells fire, rest, and die in three states, sending gliders streaming across the page like static that learned to travel. An automaton that looks alive because everything in it is either igniting or cooling.

living_paper_bubble_sort.name: Living Paper — Bubble Sort
living_paper_bubble_sort.description: Bubble sort visualized as a bar chart on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_bubble_sort.qfep_connection: Bubble sort as bars on a page — neighbors compared, the tallest drifting to the edge pass by pass. O(n²) honesty: the slowest sort, chosen because on paper you can watch it think.

living_paper_insertion_sort.name: Living Paper — Insertion Sort
living_paper_insertion_sort.description: Insertion sort visualized as a bar chart on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_insertion_sort.qfep_connection: Insertion sort at reading distance — each new bar walking left until it finds its place, the sorted region growing like a tidy shelf. The sort you use for a hand of cards, drawn as one.

living_paper_merge_sort.name: Living Paper — Merge Sort
living_paper_merge_sort.description: Merge sort visualized as a bar chart on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_merge_sort.qfep_connection: Merge sort on the page — halves sorted separately, then zipped together. Divide-and-conquer made visible: the page splits its problem the way the algorithm splits its list.

living_paper_quick_sort.name: Living Paper — Quick Sort
living_paper_quick_sort.description: Quick sort visualized as a bar chart on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_quick_sort.qfep_connection: Quick sort with its pivots — bars partitioned around a chosen value, the chaos organizing outward. The fastest common sort showing the gamble it rests on: pick a good pivot and fly, a bad one and crawl.

living_paper_sine.name: Living Paper — Sine Wave
living_paper_sine.description: Sine wave drawing itself on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_sine.qfep_connection: A page on which a sine wave draws itself — the living paper at its simplest: one line, one law, time as the pen. Hold it and you hold the chapter of waves reduced to a sheet you could pocket.

living_paper_fourier.name: Living Paper — Fourier Series
living_paper_fourier.description: Fourier series building up harmonics on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_fourier.qfep_connection: The page builds a shape harmonic by harmonic — Fourier's claim performed in ink: any curve is a sum of circles, and you watch the sum converge in your hands.

living_paper_lissajous.name: Living Paper — Lissajous Figures
living_paper_lissajous.description: Lissajous curves drawn on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_lissajous.qfep_connection: Two sines at right angles, and the page fills with Lissajous figures — the curves a pendulum signs when it swings in two directions at once. Frequency ratio as handwriting.

living_paper_mandelbrot.name: Living Paper — Mandelbrot Set
living_paper_mandelbrot.description: Mandelbrot set rendering scanline by scanline on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_mandelbrot.qfep_connection: The set arrives scanline by scanline, and only while held: an infinite boundary rationed at the speed of your patience, each finished row fossilized into the sheet.

living_paper_julia.name: Living Paper — Julia Set
living_paper_julia.description: Julia set rendering on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_julia.qfep_connection: A Julia set rendered on the sheet — the complex plane's lace at hand scale. Each pixel asks the same question (does this point escape?) and the page is the census of answers.

living_paper_sierpinski.name: Living Paper — Sierpinski Triangle
living_paper_sierpinski.description: Sierpinski triangle via chaos game on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_sierpinski.qfep_connection: Held, the paper plays the chaos game — random jumps halfway to a vertex, and the triangle emerges anyway. The order was never in the randomness but in the rule, and your grip is the only clock it gets.

living_paper_koch.name: Living Paper — Koch Snowflake
living_paper_koch.description: Koch snowflake fractal on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_koch.qfep_connection: The Koch snowflake refining itself edge by edge — the page's coastline growing longer forever inside a fixed frame. Infinity domesticated to letter size.

living_paper_tree.name: Living Paper — L-System Tree
living_paper_tree.description: L-system tree drawn stroke by stroke on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_tree.qfep_connection: An L-system tree drawn stroke by stroke — the grammar chapter's sentence-becomes-forest performed at reading distance, branch by rewritten branch.

living_paper_fern.name: Living Paper — L-System Fern
living_paper_fern.description: Barnsley fern via L-system on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_fern.qfep_connection: Barnsley's fern condensing out of random dots — four affine maps played as dice, and a plant appears. The page grows a fern with no drawing at all, only probability landing where the leaf was always going to be.

living_paper_dragon.name: Living Paper — Dragon Curve
living_paper_dragon.description: Dragon curve via L-system on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_dragon.qfep_connection: The dragon curve unfolding — the crease pattern of a strip of paper folded again and again, drawn as one unbroken line. The living paper showing what paper itself remembers when folded.

living_paper_perlin.name: Living Paper — Perlin Noise
living_paper_perlin.description: Perlin noise rendered row by row on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_perlin.qfep_connection: Perlin noise rendering row by row — coherent randomness scanned onto the sheet like a slow fax from the cloud factory. The texture every game terrain is secretly made of, shown being written.

living_paper_noise_octaves.name: Living Paper — Noise Octaves
living_paper_noise_octaves.description: Fractal noise (octave layering) on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_noise_octaves.qfep_connection: Octaves of noise stacking on one page — big slow waves plus small fast ones — until flat randomness grows the wrinkles of a landscape. Detail as ADDITION, watched layer by layer.

living_paper_bfs.name: Living Paper — BFS Flood Fill
living_paper_bfs.description: Breadth-first search flood fill on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_bfs.qfep_connection: Breadth-first search flooding the page — the frontier expanding ring by ring like water finding every floor tile at the same rate. The pathfinder's patience: nothing reached late, everything reached in order of distance.

living_paper_dfs_maze.name: Living Paper — DFS Maze
living_paper_dfs_maze.description: Depth-first search maze generation on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_dfs_maze.qfep_connection: Depth-first search carving a maze — the algorithm drilling forward, backtracking at dead ends, until every cell is visited once. The page draws a labyrinth no one designed, then holds it up.

living_paper_reaction_diffusion.name: Living Paper — Reaction-Diffusion
living_paper_reaction_diffusion.description: Turing reaction-diffusion patterns on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_reaction_diffusion.qfep_connection: Turing's patterns blooming on paper — two inks feeding and eating each other into spots and stripes. The page as petri dish: the mathematics that decorates seashells and leopard coats, hand-held.

living_paper_dla.name: Living Paper — DLA Crystal
living_paper_dla.description: Diffusion-limited aggregation crystal growth on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_dla.qfep_connection: Diffusion-limited aggregation: particles wander until they touch the crystal and stick. Frost growing on the page — the same law that shapes lightning, coral, and mineral dendrites, one random arrival at a time.

living_paper_voronoi.name: Living Paper — Voronoi Diagram
living_paper_voronoi.description: Voronoi diagram built from random seeds on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_voronoi.qfep_connection: A Voronoi diagram grown from scattered seeds — every point of the page assigned to its nearest seed, borders forming where allegiance ties. The mathematics of territories, cell walls, and closest-pizza maps, on one sheet.

living_paper_kmeans.name: Living Paper — K-Means Clustering
living_paper_kmeans.description: K-means clustering algorithm on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_kmeans.qfep_connection: K-means clustering live: centers guess, points vote, centers move — the page sorting its own scatter into neighborhoods until nobody wants to switch. Belonging computed by iteration.

living_paper_heat.name: Living Paper — Heat Diffusion
living_paper_heat.description: Heat equation diffusion on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_heat.qfep_connection: The heat equation smoothing ink like warmth through a sheet — sharp marks blurring into gradients. Diffusion as the page forgetting, evenly, everywhere at once.

living_paper_quadtree.name: Living Paper — Quadtree
living_paper_quadtree.description: Quadtree spatial subdivision on a grabbable 2D canvas.
living_paper_quadtree.qfep_connection: A quadtree subdividing wherever the page gets busy — big empty quarters left whole, crowded corners split again and again. Attention as geometry: resolution spent only where something is happening.
